case.dataRule: For vector j and flat byte index i (zero-based), seed=case.seed+j. code=((73*i+19*floor(i/256)+seed)%127)|(i%2?128:0), overridden to 0 when i%257=0 and 128 when i%263=0. scale=112+((11*i+seed)%32). Codes are row-major; scales are row-major per 32 K elements. These rules define every supplied input byte.
